# Protected framework versus user-generated files

## Master definition versus instance/run

```text
aos-w/                                  PROTECTED standardized release
  VERSION.json                          "0.1.0"
  PROTOCOL.md                           general agent instructions
  spec/schemas/template.schema.json     format rules
  templates/research-starter/
    template.yaml                       publisher-controlled master
    skills/evidence-handling/SKILL.md   publisher-controlled guidance

  agent-files/                           USER-OWNED, normally writable
    config/settings.json                current installation defaults
    custom-templates/acme-research/
      template.yaml                     user-maintained variant, independent of the master
      skills/acme-method/SKILL.md       local project skill
    instances/example-research-001/
      instance.json                     fixed instance identity/parameters
      template-lock.json                pinned version and digest/source
      template-snapshots/<digest>/template.yaml
      graph-revisions/g0001.yaml        immutable effective graph
      skills/                            instance-specific resources, if any
      runs/run-001/
        run.json                         trigger/occurrence and context
        events.jsonl                     chronological audit
        state.json                       derived current snapshot
        handoff.md                       last known progress and next step
        handoff.json                     optional structured equivalent
        checkpoints/check-001.json       validated resume boundary
        tasks/define-scope/attempts/attempt-1.json
        claims/define-scope.json         advisory claim unless host proves backend
        reviews/review-001.json          verdict on exact artifacts
        approvals/approval-001.json      scoped authority (if any)
        artifacts/scope.md              real work output
        artifacts/evidence.md           dated source record
        artifacts/summary.md            reviewed summary
        skills/                           run-specific resources, if any
```

This tree illustrates the paths generated by a run. The installed scaffold includes **one inert synthetic practice instance** under `agent-files/instances/demo-local-research/`, with CREATED state and no completed tasks, approvals, customer contacts or secrets. New real instances are created separately by the user's agent. Directories under an instance are created when the workflow is instantiated; Git never tracks empty directories.

## Which record wins?

- Master template: publisher-defined instructions *for future instances only*.
- Custom template: user-maintained definition, but changes don't silently alter already pinned runs.
- Template lock + `g0001.yaml`: **effective definition for this instance/run**.
- `events.jsonl`: validated chronological audit of what the run actually observed/did.
- `state.json`: derived snapshot, must reconcile with event sequence and checkpoint.
- `handoff.md`: agent-friendly current summary, **not** authority over missing/contradictory history.
- External provider: actual live campaign, booking, site or Git remote truth, not local state.

## Approval example

An `artifacts/summary.md` passing local evidence QC is **not** approval to activate ads. A separate, issuer-bound `approvals/<id>.json` must grant `activate_live` for exact campaign/adset/ad identities and current versions, budget and exclusions. The sample `research-starter` never grants that operation class.

## Custom template and framework upgrade

To change a master, copy into `agent-files/custom-templates/` and instantiate from the new version. Keep existing instance's template snapshot unchanged. On new AOS-W releases, back up `agent-files/`, replace only standardized files, compare `VERSION.json`, verify compatibility, and do not overwrite user data.
